TASK_LEVEL.L0: Closed retrieval/computation — verifiable answer, nothing needs to exist before execution. Orchestrator executes directly.
TASK_LEVEL.L1: Fixed goal, open path — a falsifiable checkpoint must exist before execution.
TASK_LEVEL.L2: Open goal in a bounded frame — a weighted rubric must exist before execution.
TASK_LEVEL.L3: Open frame — a user-chosen objective must exist before design, then as L2.

STAGE.INTERPRETATION: Clarifying an ambiguous prompt with the user before any analysis; for L3, also the objective-choice gate.
STAGE.PLANNING: study_designer_agent producing or revising design.md for the current phase.
STAGE.PEER_REVIEW: peer_reviewer_agent DESIGN-REVIEW or RESULTS-REVIEW for the current phase.
STAGE.USER_FEEDBACK: Presenting design.md/report.md to the user and collecting their response.
STAGE.EXECUTION: Dispatching phase tasks to specialist subagents.
STAGE.REPORTING: Compiling or presenting the final report.md after FINAL_PHASE.
